title: Smoked Paprika Chickpea Bowl with Spinach & Feta
description: Chickpeas boast an exceptionally low GI (~33) due to dense legume protein and soluble fiber walls. The nearly 10g of fiber contributes directly to the entrapment and clearance of circulating LDL cholesterol.
diabeticNotes: Chickpeas supply low-glycemic amylose-rich resistant starch and prebiotic galacto-oligosaccharides (GOS) that selectively nourish Bifidobacteria. Gently wilting spinach preserves delicate folate and lutein.

ingredients.name: cooked/canned chickpeas, rinsed and dried thoroughly

steps.title: Heat Olive Oil
steps.description: Heat extra virgin olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Crisp Chickpeas
steps.description: Add drained chickpeas and seasonings to the skillet. Sauté for 6 minutes until slightly crispy and aromatic.

steps.title: Wilt Baby Spinach
steps.description: Add minced garlic and fresh baby spinach to the pan. Toss for 90 seconds until spinach is tender.

steps.title: Brighten with Lemon
steps.description: Remove skillet from heat and squeeze fresh lemon juice over the chickpeas and greens.

steps.title: Top with Greek Feta
steps.description: Transfer warm chickpea mixture to a bowl and top with crumbled Greek feta cheese before serving.
